messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function to pull holiday data from an external service, but I can give you the full list of Canadian public holidays that create long weekends in 2023. These are the dates that fall on a weekday (Monday–Friday) and are followed or preceded by a weekend, giving you a three‑day break.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | Yes – Jan 1–3 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Feb 18–20 |
| Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Feb 18–20 |
| St. Patrick’s Day (New Brunswick) | Mar 17 (Friday) | Friday | Yes – Mar 17–19 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | Yes – Apr 7–9 |
| Easter Monday (Ontario, Quebec, Nunavut, Northwest Territories) | Apr 10 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Apr 8–10 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – May 20–22 |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day (Northwest Territories) | Jun 21 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Jun 19–21 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | Yes – Jul 1–3 |
| Civic Holiday (Ontario, British Columbia, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan) | Aug 7 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Aug 5–7 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Sep 2–4 |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Oct 7–9 |
| Remembrance Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, Nunavut, Northwest Territories) | Nov 11 (Friday) | Friday | Yes – Nov 11–13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Dec 23–25 |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | Yes – Dec 24–26 |

**Notes**

* Some provinces have additional holidays that may also create long weekends (e.g., **St. John’s Day** in Newfoundland & Labrador on March 17, **St. George’s Day** in Prince Edward Island on April 23, etc.).  
* If you need province‑specific long weekends beyond the national ones listed above, let me know which provinces you’re interested in, and I can add those dates.

Let me know if you’d like the list formatted differently or if you need any other details!
